spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_liquid_momentum
spec.hypothesis: Short-window taker buy/sell volume imbalance at the open in liquid, tight-spread large-caps predicts 15-30min continuation, net of T1 costs -- a new signal on a different (liquid) universe than the twice-failed qhour_open/altbasket combo.
spec.power_argument: Proxy sigma ~45bps/trade for liquid mega-caps (vs ~110bps implied for the altbasket in sprint32). At n=300, 80%-power alpha=0.05 MDE = 2.8*sigma/sqrt(n) ~= 7.3bps, above the ~2-4bps T1 round-trip cost floor and within a plausible order-flow edge.
